details: This package is a fork of the Baileys WhatsApp library. A a static rule matched on keyword co-occurrence (a 'ping' token near HTTP GET calls) in lib/Utils/generics.js, but the surrounding context in Baileys generics utilities is consistent with normal networking helpers rather than a traced installer-harm path. No concrete evidence was captured of installer-secret reads, hardcoded attacker C2, install-time fetch-and-execute, credential harvesting, or silent-relay of caller data to a non-first-party destination. Because this is a fork of a widely-used library, unverified forks can carry covert modifications (for example, undocumented actions performed with the consumer's authenticated session) that are not visible from this single pattern hit.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
